Expert Chairside Support for Maximum Efficiency

From pre-fabricated GFMR provisionals to record-taking for final restorations, 3DDX brings digital workflow expertise directly into your practice.

Request Chairside Assistance Book Elite IPG Support

More than just support; An extension to your team

Immediate loading via the pre-fabricated MagnetiX™ GFMR workflow (Intra-oral pickup)

Post-surgical implant data capture using Photogrammetry and Grammetry solutions for GFMP/FMP workflows (Screw-retained).

Final implant records taking for definitive restorations

How Chairside Assistance
Fits Into Your Workflow

GFMR

Immediate Loading

Support with seating and refining the pre-fabricated provisional restoration, including pickup, occlusal adjustments, and finishing & polishing before delivery.

GFMP / FMP

Photogrammetry Capture

Assist with IPG to capture implant positions immediately after surgery to generate highly accurate restorative records.

Further support for chairside 3D printing can be provided through our limited Mobile Lab Service.

Final Restorations

Provide IPG and chairside scanning for healed cases requiring definitive implant impressions for passive-fit final restorations.

Photogrammetry Services

Accurate Implant Records—Without Capital Investment

Complete implant position capture with a wide range of system compatibility and support, including photogrammetry-dedicated scanners such as Micronmapper or iCam, and Shining 3D’s Elite IPG (Intraoral Photogrammetry).
Utilize grammetry technology with 3DDX proprietary system, Optisplint by Digital Arches, or any horizontal scanbody technology that works with your existing Intraoral Scanner.

The Shining 3D Elite IPG technology enables clinicians to capture implant positions with extremely high accuracy (up to 5 μm) via its two-in-one capabilities, featuring both photogrammetry and intraoral scanning in a single compact device.

Key Benefits

Why Clinicians Choose 3DDX Chairside Assistance

On-Site Clinical Support

Expert chairside assistance during critical phases of implant and restorative workflows.

High-Accuracy Implant Capture

Flexible Workflow Compatibility

Supports both guided and freehand implant protocols, integrating seamlessly into existing clinical workflows.

Seamless Transition to Final Restorations

Simplifies the move from provisional to definitive prosthetics through verified digital records.

Enhanced Restorative Coordination

Improves communication, verification, and workflow efficiency in the workflow

Greater Clinical Confidence

Expert guidance and validated digital workflows help reduce complexity, improve predictability, and support successful restorative outcomes.
